text: Figure 4.33: textual information in annotations Class GeneralAnnotation (abstract) Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::GenericStructure::GeneralT emplateClasses::GeneralAnnotation Note This class represents textual comments (called annotations) which relate to the object in which it is aggregated. These annotations are intended for use during the development process for transferring information from one step of the development process to the next one. The approach is similar to the "yellow pads" ... This abstract class can be specialized in order to add some further formal properties.
